HAPPY BIRTHDAY TO MY GIRL, MY PERSON, MY FELICIA! ❤️🥹

Where do I even begin? How do I put over six years of friendship, countless memories, laughter, tears, arguments, forgiveness, and unconditional love into one birthday message? Honestly, I don’t think words will ever be enough to express how much you mean to me Feli ,if someone had told me back in Class 6 that the girl I was becoming friends with would become such an important part of my life, I probably wouldn’t have understood just how special that would be. Look at us now🥹From class 6 all the way now and all the different phases of life we’ve experienced together. We’ve literally grown together. We’ve watched each other change, learn, make mistakes, overcome things and become the people we are today.
